THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
101
STUDY 079
Reindeer Cardigan by the Window
Rights check / Repeats Study 106.
Source: 24983.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy light brown
hair and thin round glasses sits on a window ledge,
holding a small ginger kitten. She wears a brown and
cream reindeer-pattern knit cardigan over a charcoal
turtleneck, with a burgundy plaid skirt. Her expression
is thoughtful, looking off to the side. Soft, diffused
window light, a palette of chocolate, cream, and
burgundy. Cozy and nostalgic, in the style of a winter
knitwear lookbook.
Cozy, nostalgic, soft
WORKING NOTES
- The reindeer knit pattern and kitten are the focal points.
- Keep the window light for a soft, cozy glow.
Try this: Keep the window light for a soft glow.
